died.name: Thomas Arnold
died.cause: to his physician, who had described his serious prognosis and treatment

died.name: William Cullen Bryant
died.cause: He had fallen and hit his head on the sidewalk; Miss Fairchild was his niece
died.last_words: Whose house is this? What street are we in? Why did you bring me here? Would you like to see Miss Fairchild?

died.name: Major Lloyd W. Williams
died.cause: to his approaching medics, after being gassed and hit by German shrapnel during the Battle of Belleau Wood in World War I
died.last_words: Don't bother with me. Take care of my good men.

died.name: Jimmy L. Glass
died.last_words: Yeah, I think I'd rather be fishing.

born.name: Charles Kingsley
born.desc: English priest, university professor and author
born.cause: quoting from the Burial Service in the Book of Common Prayer
born.last_words: Thou knowest, O Lord, the secrets of our hearts; shut not Thy merciful ears to our prayer, but spare us, O Lord most holy, O God most mighty, O holy and merciful Saviour, Thou most worthy Judge Eternal, suffer us not at our last hour, from any pains of death, to fall from Thee.

born.name: Anton Gag
born.last_words: What Papa couldn't do, Wanda will have to finish.
